/usr/bin/openssl verify -CAfile "$HOME/ca.pem" -verify_hostname trace.test "$HOME/server.pem" >"$HOME/verify-good.out" 2>"$HOME/verify-good.err"
if /usr/bin/openssl verify -CAfile "$HOME/wrong-ca.pem" -verify_hostname trace.test "$HOME/server.pem" >"$HOME/verify-wrong-ca.out" 2>"$HOME/verify-wrong-ca.err"; then exit 31; fi
if /usr/bin/openssl verify -CAfile "$HOME/ca.pem" -verify_hostname wrong.trace.test "$HOME/server.pem" >"$HOME/verify-wrong-sni.out" 2>"$HOME/verify-wrong-sni.err"; then exit 32; fi
./trace-vm-nts-r1.py --control
